heading.title: Suits for Breach of the Contract

article.title: Damages for non-delivery.
article.content: Where the seller wrongfully neglects or refuses to deliver the goods to the buyer, the buyer may sue the seller for damages for non-delivery.
article.html:
57Damages for non-delivery.

Section 57 · Chapter VI · page 14 of the Act

Where the seller wrongfully neglects or refuses to deliver the goods to the buyer, the buyer may sue the seller for damages for non-delivery.
